title: KESTRUM
subtitle: Every kingdom begins with a place.

text.help_pan: Drag the landscape with one finger or the left mouse button to pan.
text.help_zoom: Pinch to zoom, or tap + and -. Tap Recenter to see the whole map.
text.help_turn: Tap End Turn to finish your orders. All factions act before the season advances and saves.
text.help_menu: Tap Menu for saving, loading, settings, and returning to the title.
text.help_scope: Rivals currently pass. Tap Pause to hold their progress, Step for one phase, or Resume to continue.
